proposed_comments.title: Use culture-aware percentages (1/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### Use culture-aware percentages (1/5)

**Severity:** `medium`

The summary appends a literal `%`, so a locale such as `fr-FR` receives `25%` instead of its `25 %` percent pattern. Formatting the fraction with `P0` follows the culture's symbol placement and spacing.

```suggestion
                .Append(string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "{0:P0}", shares[i]));
```

Apply all five related changes together.

> If applying multiple suggestions individually, use "Commit suggestion" from bottom to top, or batch them with "Add suggestion to batch" then "Commit suggestions" to apply atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Use culture-aware percentages (4/5)
proposed_comments.body:
### Use culture-aware percentages (4/5)

**Severity:** `medium`

The gauge change uses the invariant culture's percent pattern, which includes a space. Update this expectation and cover the `fr-FR` pattern so the test matches the new formatting.

```suggestion
        Assert.AreEqual("100 %", new GaugeChartModel { Value = 150 }.FormatValue(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
        Assert.AreEqual("25 %", new GaugeChartModel { Value = 25 }.FormatValue(CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("fr-FR")));
```

Apply all five related changes together.
